data.exact_reserve_text: The result, as detailed above, is driven by a general trend of reductions in incurred claims due to favourable settlement of claims, including releases chiefly from Construction Defect contracts. This favourable experience reflects the efficiency of the Syndicate's long established claims management capabilities which the Agency considers a competitive advantage.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Releases chiefly from Construction Defect contracts contributed to favourable reductions in incurred claims / reserves.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced favourable claims development in 2015, with reductions in legacy reserves and releases primarily attributed to favourable settlements (notably from Construction Defect contracts). Gross technical provisions reduced from GBP 96.6m to GBP 87.8m over the year, with reductions on legacy business partly offset by increased IBNR on live business. No explicit gross prior-year reserve movement figure was disclosed in the technical movements notes; the narrative indicates an overall release.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross prior-year reserve movement (gross PYD) figure is presented in the 'movement in prior year's provision' style note. The document contains narrative stating releases (favourable development) and shows opening and closing gross claims outstanding (96.644m  87.761m). A gross claims development triangle is present but is incomplete in the published note (many intermediate development cells blank), so it could not be reliably used to compute a definitive gross PYD. As a result prior_year_development_gbp_m is returned as null. Premium and segmental figures are taken from the Segmental Analysis note. Some small negative/odd values appear in the regulatory breakdown (e.g. Marine = -8k) as presented in the source.
